vector_memory.semantic_summary: This interface defines the BlendingMode structure, serving as a critical data contract within the rendering subsystem. It encapsulates the necessary factorssourcefactor and destfactorthat govern how two colors or values interact during a graphics blending operation. It ensures consistent application of blending parameters derived from the blend.enum for shader state management.
